posts.title_en: Guild Conquest 513G guide (Skill Haste) - 서신우
posts.summary_en: 서신우's post-9/23 update: 색동주머니 replaces Panda, and a separate raid gear preset (9/23 presets) puts Skill Haste on accessories instead of stage Accuracy/Focus. Power falls from 1.89G to 1.52G, but the score at the 36 s mark rises from ~40G to ~100G. He says a haste setup should deal 300-400x power ('1인분'), against ~100x without haste. The pinned comment explains the ATK order, Lv.1 fillers and Cherry. Full rune pages were transcribed from the video.
